title: Topological Equivalence of Spectral and Density Cluster Hierarchies
abstract: arXiv:2610.31909v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We compare two canonical ways to recover hierarchical clustering from an underlying density $f$: the \emph{density cluster tree} given by connected components of superlevel sets $\{f\ge\lambda\}$, and a \emph{spectral hierarchy} obtained by applying single linkage to diffusion distances induced by a Laplacian operator. We give conditions under which, at an appropriate diffusion time, the diffusion hierarchy is \emph{topologically equivalent} to the density cluster tree up to a monotone rescaling of heights. It further shows that a $k$-NN graph implementation inherits this equivalence from uniform approximation of diffusion distances, yielding a finite-sample reduction from spectral graph constructions to density-level-set topology.

translated_title: 谱聚类层次结构与密度聚类层次结构的拓扑等价性
translated_abstract: 我们比较了从底层密度函数 $f$ 恢复层次聚类的两种经典方法：一种是由超水平集 $\{f\ge\lambda\}$ 的连通分支给出的密度聚类树，另一种是对由拉普拉斯算子诱导的扩散距离应用单链接方法得到的谱层次结构。我们给出了这样的条件：在适当的扩散时间下，扩散层次结构与密度聚类树在高度的单调重缩放意义下是拓扑等价的。论文进一步表明，$k$-近邻（$k$-NN）图实现通过扩散距离的一致逼近继承了这种等价性，从而实现了从谱图构造到密度水平集拓扑的有限样本归约。
tldr: 本文证明了在适当条件下，基于扩散距离的谱聚类层次结构与基于密度超水平集的密度聚类树在拓扑上等价，且该等价性可通过k-近邻图实现推广到有限样本情形。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that, under appropriate conditions, the spectral hierarchy based on diffusion distances is topologically equivalent to the density cluster tree built from superlevel sets, and this equivalence extends to finite samples via k-NN graph implementations.
